mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO shows a sustained 3-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO is declining and UNRATE is rising.
